title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1 buz Bardhyl str.
description_en: Apartment for sale 2+1 buz Bardhyl str. It is located on the 3rd floor of an existing 4-story building (east and south-west orientation). The apartment has been completely restored from scratch. Plastering, electrical, hydraulic, multilayer, flush toilet, new doors, plastic windows, thermal double glazing, parquet, painting skates, etc. The surface is about 70 meters, but the certificate says 58 m².
